production.note: Dodge: production of the 2016 Viper ACR begins in Detroit in the third quarter of 2015. End year: the last Viper left Conner Avenue Assembly in the week of 14 August 2017 (Motor Authority, source motorauthority-last-viper-2017). Model years 2016-2017.

transmission.note: Tremec TR6060; no automatic was offered

weightLb.note: Standard ACR without the optional Extreme Aero Package. Autoblog reports the claimed curb weight as 3,392 lb in Aero trim with the standard ACR 18 lb lighter (3,392 - 18 = 3,374). Dodge's own 2016 spec sheet publishes only the Extreme Aero figure, 3,392 lb (1,539 kg).

sources.title: New 2016 Dodge Viper ACR - Fastest Street-legal Viper Track Car Ever
The last Dodge Viper has rolled off the assembly line

discrepancies.reason: Option package: 3,392 lb is the ACR with the optional Extreme Aero Package (the only ACR figure on Dodge's spec sheet); 3,374 lb is the standard ACR, which Autoblog reports as 18 lb lighter.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,374 lb because the guide asks for the lightest standard configuration and option packages do not count. The figure is derived from a publication's statement of the manufacturer claim, so confidence is medium.
